name: relion.ctffind.tomo
label: Relion Tomo CTF Estimation
help: RELION CTFFIND-4.1 CTF estimation for tomography tilt series. Matches RelionJob::initialiseCtffindJob with is_tomo=true and produces tilt_series_ctf.star with per-tilt CTF metadata.

params.name: input_star_mics
params.label: Input tilt series:
params.help: A motion-corrected tilt series STAR file. RELION will estimate CTF parameters for each tilt image.

params.name: do_phaseshift
params.label: Estimate phase shifts?
params.help: If set to Yes, CTFFIND4 will estimate phase shifts, for example those introduced by a Volta phase plate.

params.name: phase_min
params.label: Phase shift (deg) - Min:
params.help: Minimum phase shift to search, in degrees.

params.name: phase_max
params.label: Phase shift (deg) - Max:
params.help: Maximum phase shift to search, in degrees.

params.name: phase_step
params.label: Phase shift (deg) - Step:
params.help: Phase-shift search step size, in degrees.

params.name: dast
params.label: Amount of astigmatism (A):
params.help: CTFFIND's dAst parameter. This value is suitable for most data sets on reasonably well-aligned microscopes.

params.name: fn_ctffind_exe
params.label: CTFFIND-4.1 executable:
params.help: Location of the CTFFIND release 4.1 or later executable.

params.name: use_given_ps
params.label: Use power spectra from MotionCorr job?
params.help: If set to Yes, estimate CTF parameters using power spectra calculated during motion correction. This is recommended when those power spectra are available, and is required when motion correction wrote float16 images.

params.name: slow_search
params.label: Use exhaustive search?
params.help: If set to Yes, CTFFIND4 will use a slower but more exhaustive search. This can help when astigmatism or phase shifts are difficult to fit.

params.name: ctf_win
params.label: Estimate CTF on window size (pix):
params.help: If positive, use a centered square window of this size for CTF estimation. A negative value uses the original tilt image.

params.name: resmin
params.label: Minimum resolution (A):
params.help: Lowest resolution used for CTF estimation. For the tutorial data this is 50 A.

params.name: resmax
params.label: Maximum resolution (A):
params.help: Highest resolution used for CTF estimation in the lowest-dose image.

params.name: dfmin
params.label: Minimum defocus value (A):
params.help: Minimum defocus search value. This is ignored when Nominal defocus search range is positive.

params.name: dfmax
params.label: Maximum defocus value (A):
params.help: Maximum defocus search value. This is ignored when Nominal defocus search range is positive.

params.name: localsearch_nominal_defocus
params.label: Nominal defocus search range (A):
params.help: If positive, search within plus or minus this value around the nominal defocus from the input STAR file. Set to zero or a negative value to use the overall minimum and maximum defocus ranges instead.

params.name: exp_factor_dose
params.label: Dose-dependent Thon ring fading (e/A2):
params.help: If positive, lower the maximum resolution used for CTF estimation as accumulated dose increases. A value of 100 e/A2 gives an exp(1) reduction factor at 100 e/A2. Set to zero or a negative value to keep the maximum resolution fixed.
